name: organization-ablations
description: Live SkillJuror-lite ablations: compare skill organization arms under equal-budget live runs. Replay CI uses stub traces only (no LLM judge).

scenarios.name: ablation review: primary-first arm
scenarios.prompt:
Review staged changes in agent-suites/fixtures/sample-app/src/redirect.ts. Review only; do not edit or commit.

Read `.claude/skills/code-review/SKILL.md` first. Default primary-first — no council unless escalation criteria match.

judge: The agent completed a primary review without spawning council or Task members

scenarios.name: ablation review: council escalation arm
scenarios.prompt:
Review staged changes in agent-suites/fixtures/sample-app/src/auth.ts with security and API council escalation. Review only.

Read `.claude/skills/code-review/SKILL.md` and escalate per escalation.md.

judge: The agent escalated to council or multi specialists as requested after primary framing

scenarios.name: ablation multi: fit-check skip arm
scenarios.prompt:
Map how auth works in agent-suites/fixtures/sample-app. Use subagents if parallel helps.

Read `.claude/skills/subagents/SKILL.md` first and apply Fit check.

judge: The agent named a single-pass rival and skipped parallel spawn for this sequential repo map
